source_locator: Page 452 of 489, CITY OF RIVERSIDE MAYOR, Grand Totals row; column positions checked against candidate headers
verification_note: Six candidates ran. Bailey has 33,033 of 51,864 candidate votes, a majority of about 64 percent. The runner-up is Paul Davis with 7,994 votes. The November 2016 county statement of vote has no Riverside mayoral contest. Riverside City Charter Sec. 400(c) states that if in an election for a ward Councilmember or for the office of Mayor no candidate receives a majority of the total votes cast, the City Council calls a special election and the top two candidates run in it. A majority winner is therefore elected without a further round. Text read through api.municode.com (Code of Ordinances, Supplement 33). Sec. 400(c) is the text as amended on November 3, 2020; the pre-2020 text was not opened. The 2012 official statement of vote shows a mayoral runoff after a majority was not reached in June, consistent with the rule for the earlier period.
